plan.topic: Losing weight on tirzepatide? 3 ways to start strength training
plan.angle: Direct 'you' hook, named drug, numbered promise, answered with data by about 10 s: 'In the SURMOUNT-1 body-scan substudy (adults with obesity, or overweight with a weight-related condition, without diabetes), about three-quarters of the weight lost was fat.' Then 3 guideline-recommended starts: (1) muscle-strengthening at least 2 days a week, starting gently; (2) a protein food at each meal unless your clinician has told you to limit protein; (3) progress slowly with bodyweight or bands. 'Recommended', not 'proven on tirzepatide'. One GI side-effect line, the prescriber line, and 'follow for more' unless L1 is already published. 170 words or fewer.

package.title: 3 Ways to Start Strength Training on Tirzepatide #shorts
package.description:
Losing weight on tirzepatide? In SURMOUNT-1's body-scan substudy (adults with obesity, or overweight with a weight-related condition, without diabetes), about 75% of weight lost over 72 weeks was fat and about 25% was lean mass, which includes muscle. 3 recommended habits, not proven on tirzepatide itself: strength train 2+ days/week (start gently), add protein at each meal (kidney disease or told to limit protein? check with your clinician first), and progress slowly. Common side effects are stomach-related, like nausea, mostly mild to moderate.

This content is for educational purposes only and is not medical advice. Always talk to a qualified healthcare professional about your own situation. Talk to your doctor or prescriber about whether it's right for you.

Sources:
1. Body composition changes during weight reduction with tirzepatide in the SURMOUNT-1 study of adults with obesity or overweight — Diabetes, Obesity and Metabolism, 2025. https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11965027/
2. Tirzepatide Once Weekly for the Treatment of Obesity — NEJM, 2022. https://www.nejm.org/doi/full/10.1056/NEJMoa2206038
3. Adult Activity: An Overview — CDC, reviewed Dec 20, 2023. https://www.cdc.gov/physical-activity-basics/guidelines/adults.html
4. Nutritional priorities to support GLP-1 therapy for obesity — American Journal of Clinical Nutrition, 2025. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ajcnut.2025.04.023

factcheck.summary: I checked every claim against its source, and they hold up. The SURMOUNT-1 DXA body-scan substudy (Look et al., Diabetes Obes Metab 2025, doi 10.1111/dom.16275) reports that 74% of the weight lost was fat and 26% was lean mass. That figure pools the tirzepatide doses (n=124, with 36 on placebo) and covers adults without type 2 diabetes over 72 weeks, so "about three-quarters" and the stated population are correct. CDC's "Adult Activity: An Overview" (last reviewed Dec 20, 2023) says, in these words, "muscle-strengthening activities on 2 or more days a week that work all major muscle groups." The joint ACLM/ASN/OMA/TOS advisory exists in AJCN 2025 at the DOI given, and one of its priorities is adequate protein plus strength training to keep lean mass. The NEJM SURMOUNT-1 paper backs the line that side effects are mostly mild-to-moderate stomach problems. The safety pieces are all in place: the hedge "recommended habits, not proven on tirzepatide itself", "start gently", the kidney caveat, the side-effect line and the exact prescriber line. The script is about 150 words. There are three minor issues: (1) the hook promises 3 strength-training starts, but tip 2 is about protein; (2) "at each meal" is our own practical tip, and I couldn't confirm the advisory says it in those words; (3) the s2 stat attribution leaves out the group size.

issues.claim: Here are 3 ways to start strength training.
issues.problem: Tip 2 (s4) is about protein, not strength training, so the hook doesn't fully match what the video delivers.
issues.fix: s1 narration: "Losing weight on tirzepatide? Here are 3 ways to start strength training, and fuel it." Leave the on-screen text and title as they are, or change the title to "Losing Weight on Tirzepatide? 3 Ways to Protect Your Muscle #shorts".

issues.claim: nutrition experts recommend prioritising protein, so add a protein food at each meal
issues.problem: The advisory recommends adequate protein together with strength training. I couldn't confirm it says "each meal" in those words. The "so" makes it fine as our own tip, but the tie to the source should be clearer.
issues.fix: "Two: nutrition experts recommend getting enough protein. One easy way: add a protein food at each meal, like eggs, yogurt, fish or beans. Have kidney disease, or been told to limit protein? Check with your clinician first."

issues.claim: SURMOUNT-1 DXA substudy, tirzepatide doses pooled (Look et al., 2025)
issues.problem: The house rules require the group size on the stat. The pooled tirzepatide arm was n=124 out of 160 scanned (36 on placebo).
issues.fix: "SURMOUNT-1 DXA substudy, 124 on tirzepatide (doses pooled), 72 wks, adults without diabetes (Look et al., 2025)"

audio.soundNotes: Music sat right in the target window under speech (-13.5dB) so only a small +1dB nudge was applied; pause swells are a touch low (-17.9dB) but a flat multiplier can't fix that without risking the under-voice ceiling, so it's left to the auto-ducking curve. Trimmed a 6-cue cluster at the "~3/4" reveal down to 4, thinned a 4-pop swarm around the protein tip to 2, pulled down three cues that spiked 7-12dB too loud over narration (t=19.86, 33.94, 48.12), and pushed the quiet, inaudible pause-swell at t=19.08 to the gain cap since it undershot the reveal target. Added five bespoke, understated accents (scanner hum, reveal shimmer, dumbbell clink, fork clink, outro chime) to give key beats texture the stock kit lacked without ever competing with the narrator.
